items.text: An MBA in real estate and infrastructure management points toward development, sales and leasing, valuation, project finance, facility management and public infrastructure roles, and it pays off mainly when combined with site-level knowledge, rule awareness and a clear target segment.
Pick a segment first, residential, commercial, industrial or public infrastructure, learn its approvals and cash flow, and then judge programmes by outcomes.
Check current official rules and never rely on sales claims alone.
